title: Hotel, 4-Storey Wood Frame
scope: 120-key hotel: concrete podium slab, light-gauge wood frame in two wings, trusses and roof, envelope following the frame, then MEP and finishes floor by floor.
assume: Two 31 m × 17 m wings, 3.2 m floor-to-floor, double-loaded corridor; panelised walls 2.4 m wide; trusses at 600 mm.
Envelope (WRB, windows, siding) follows the frame floor by floor; interior MEP waits for dry-in.
